defects.reported: 修复MPD角色模型配置保存不生效问题（不论web、desktop还是tui）
defects.rootCause: The saved `teamModels.slot{1..4}` knobs were persisted (profile `cordis.patch.yml` row config of `mpd-config`) and served resolved by `mpdConfig.get("teamModels")`, but the ONLY reader was `mpd-roster-provider-plugin` (official `spawn_teammate`). Every one-shot path used the STATIC `roles.data.ts` chains, while `mpd_role_spawn`'s own description and `roster-section.ts` both promised the slots apply there.
measuredEvidence: ~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui/cordis.patch.yml lines 14-32: mpd-config row config carries teamModels.slot1..4 = { provider: company-api, model: deepseek-flash, reasoningEffort: max } — the SAVE persisted.
~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml lines 61-76: mpd-config row config carries the same block with provider `companyapi`.

A real one-shot spawn on this machine died instantly: child session 8281f350-8cc0-4e32-a07f-6a354f46b7bf recorded `subagent/descriptor {provider:"spawn",label:"Deep Worker"}` then `assistant/attempt finish reason=error failure.message="llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route \"deepseek-official\"; ... code: MISSING_CREDENTIAL"` — i.e. the static shipped route, NOT the saved `company-api` slot route.
The tool call returned `role: Deep Worker, status: complete, summary: ""`: the failure was swallowed as an empty report.
fix: packages/mpd-config-plugin/src/index.ts: new exported `teamModelSlotOfMember(member)` and `teamModelRouteOfMember(member, config)` (membership from the ONE `TEAM_MODEL_SLOT_GROUPS` declaration, resolved over `withTeamModelsDefaults`), plus the new `mpdConfig` service member `teamModelRouteOf(member)`. Reached as a SERVICE, so NO new cross-package import was added (the frozen coupling inventory stays untouched).

packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/index.ts: `roleSurface` overlays the base role's chain with the configured slot route (per call, never cached), which is the ONE read every consumer shares — `mpd_roles_list`, `mpd_role_spawn`, the workmate library (via `mpdRoles`) and `mpd_modelchain_resolve` (which prefers `spec.chain`). `mpd_role_spawn` also passes the slot's `reasoningEffort` through `agentOptions`.

packages/mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src/index.ts: `DshSpawnSpec.agentOptions` widened to carry `reasoningEffort` — the same file's own doc already described the harness-shaped options as provider/model/reasoningEffort and `spawnAgent` forwards the object verbatim, so the type was incomplete.
packages/mpd-config-plugin/README.md + README.zh-CN.md: the service list gains `teamModelRouteOf(member)` (bilingual pair updated together).

defects.reported: 修复在windows端dsh-TUI调用时侧边栏完全不显示问题
defects.rootCause: The host-backed sidebar lane could not RUN on win32 at all, so no Windows regression in this area was observable. Four suites resolved the installed host root POSIX-only: `Bun.which("dsh-tui")` -> `readlink -f` -> `dirname(dirname(real))`, which assumes `<root>/bin/dsh-tui.js` behind a symlink. On win32 the launcher is the shim `%APPDATA%\npm\dsh-tui.ps1`, so the root resolved to `%APPDATA%\Roaming`.
measuredEvidence: BEFORE: `bun test packages/mpd-tui-plugin/test/panel-visibility.test.ts` -> `error: Cannot find module 'C:\Users\zhao.yinan\AppData\Roaming\lib\types\tuiDisplayPrefs.js' from ...panel-visibility.test.ts'`; 0 pass / 1 fail / exit 1.

AFTER: the same command -> 66 pass / 0 fail across panel-visibility + panel-enable-migration, including `the adapter DOES append a registered id to the CSV`, `the host REWRITES the CSV from configuration, which is how a registered panel disappears`, `a sidebar splits only at CHAT_MIN + PANEL_MIN + DIVIDER`, and R13d `the host's OWN append does NOT stand the keeper down, and the mirror's rewrite IS repaired`.

The panel registration itself was already proven on this machine by the adapter's own record `.mpd/logs/mpd-tui-panels.json` (version 3, provenance readBack `tuiPanels.list`, host 0.14.0, ids `act1:team`, `act1:workmate`).

The production prefs machinery was probed directly on win32 and WORKS: `probeHostPrefs(hostRootCandidates())` bound `~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui/node_modules/@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`, read `DEFAULT_SIDE_PANEL_IDS = todo,jobs,agents,info,trajectory,workspace,btw,companion`, the live CSV equal to that default, `subscribeSidePanelPanels` present, and `applySidePanelPanels(<csv> + ",act1:team")` returned the CSV with the id appended.
fix: packages/mpd-tui-plugin/test/lib/host-root.ts: NEW shared `installedHostRoot(launcher)` — tries the POSIX symlink resolution first, then walks UP from the launcher's own directory looking for `node_modules/@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`, and VALIDATES every candidate by the host files it must carry (`lib/types/tuiDisplayPrefs.js`); unresolvable launchers THROW naming every path tried, so the lane can never pass vacuously.
packages/mpd-tui-plugin/test/panel-visibility.test.ts, panel-legend-mount.test.ts, session-scope-and-push.test.ts: use it (the local POSIX-only `hostRoot()` bodies removed).
packages/mpd-tui-adapter-plugin/test/panel-enable-migration.test.ts: same portable resolution, self-contained (no cross-package test import).
defects.residualBound: The reported SYMPTOM (no sidebar on screen) is gated by TWO host-side switches this bundle does not own and cannot read without a further counted host-internals contact: the side panel starts CLOSED (`sidePanel.open: false` schema default; the user must open it with the host's own key) and it only splits at >= 93 columns (`CHAT_MIN_COLUMNS 64 + PANEL_MIN_COLUMNS 28 + DIVIDER 1`), which an 80-column Windows console never reaches. The bundle's own automation (register + enable-list keeper/feed) was verified working on this host. The user-runnable remedy for a profile whose settings layer carries no panel ids remains `node scripts/mpd-tui-panels.ts` (dry-run by default, `--apply` to write).
